retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style airbrushed space scene featuring a mechanical craft orbiting a planet with a prominent metallic logo in the upper third.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast orbital scene where a complex, mechanical spacecraft—resembling a musical instrument—descends toward a cloud-covered blue planet, framed by a dark space void and a sharp, metallic title banner.
coreVisualRelationships: Mechanical craft angled diagonally against the planetary curve
Golden metallic logo anchored in the black void of space
Atmospheric blue planet providing a textured background
Sharp highlights on metal surfaces contrasting with deep shadows
coreInvariants: Diagonal composition of the primary subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large mechanical craft occupies the right-center, angled downward; a large logo spans the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The golden metallic logo at the top acts as the primary anchor, followed by the bright white of the spacecraft.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top logo down the diagonal line of the spacecraft toward the bottom-left planetary surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper black void provides high-contrast negative space for the logo and the craft's upper edge.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and polished chrome (logo and craft details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black space and the bright white/gold elements; desaturated blues in the planet.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, wide serif with flared terminals
letterConstructionRules: Letters are enclosed within a pointed, wing-like frame
Strong horizontal emphasis with thick strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' and 'N' are elongated to follow the outer taper of the frame
Internal counters are small and circular
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom logo with no secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a blue planet from orbit with a black space void at the top. Include a mechanical, guitar-shaped spacecraft with chrome pipes and green glowing ports descending at a 45-degree angle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom vector logo at the top center. The logo should be beveled gold within a pointed horizontal frame, featuring wide, heavy serif lettering with a metallic sheen.

verificationChecks: Is the logo beveled and metallic?
Does the craft have a diagonal orientation?
Is the planetary surface textured like clouds?
Is the top background pure black?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold sheen on the logo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the logo is centered and dominant
Verify the spacecraft looks mechanical and heavy
Check for the characteristic 70s 'glow' on highlights
Confirm the planet has a curved horizon line
Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Mechanical Object] with [Environment: Orbital Space] using [Style: 70s Airbrush] and [Typography: Beveled Metallic Banner].
